title: tree-methanogens: code and data for 'Methane emissions from upland tree stems reflect a balance of microbial production and consumption'
description: Analysis code and data for Gewirtzman, Arnold et al., Methane emissions from upland tree stems reflect a balance of microbial production and consumption (preprint: 10.1101/2025.09.30.679632). Stem and soil CH4 fluxes, ddPCR gene abundances (mcrA, pmoA, mmoX), 16S rRNA amplicons, and the forest inventory from Yale-Myers Forest, Connecticut, USA (2020–2023). See README.md for how to run the pipeline and README_data.md for the datasets. Code: MIT; data: CC BY 4.0.
